_comment: Optional. Copy to webassign.json. WebAssign assignments (which the LMS doesn't list), copied by hand, keyed by course code. Rows are [title, type (Homework|Pre-Class|Quiz), due (ISO 8601 with offset), earned or null, possible, recorded (YYYY-MM-DD the score was entered; optional, or null), dep (optional: the number after `dep=` in the assignment's WebAssign address, to link straight to it)]. `url` is where other rows link: your LMS's WebAssign link signs you in, a plain WebAssign page may not. `earlyBonus`: finishing `hours` before the due time earns `percent` extra on the listed types.
